title: A canonical digest for a pipe-inspection survey
heading: Hash the Validated Content in Canonical Form, Not the File
cases: the same survey with its keys in another order and another layout has the same digest; one changed reading changes it
segments listed in another order are the same survey
tags listed in another order are the same survey
readings are taken in order along the pipe, so reversing them is a different survey
0.1 + 0.2 and 0.3 are the same rate at three decimals
a rate of -0.0 is the rate 0.0
a rate of NaN has no canonical form and is refused with ValueError
the bytes are exactly the documented form, so the digest matches the one the other team pinned
